evidence.quote: So if we're looking at two meta campaigns next to each other, we can compare rorowaz, we can use that to make decisions. But if we start comparing platforms, if we start zooming out and making larger business level decisions based on these numbers, that's where we can start to mislead ourselves and go into using low reliability, low data integrity level metric.
